python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,sys,http.client,pathlib,subprocess
sha="3fa459f9216471f285411a183894bdbc3bb4830f"
def check(name,ok):
 print(name+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(200000)
 finally:c.close()
actual=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
check("SOURCE_SHA",actual==sha)
status,body=get("/healthz")
check("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==sha)
status,body=get("/library")
check("OWNER_LIBRARY",status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
for suite in ("test_discovery.py","test_discovery_engine.py","test_library.py","test_assistant.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 check("OFFLINE_"+suite,p.returncode==0)
print("PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
